settings.title: Server Settings
settings.externalDesc: Expose the panel via a TLS subdomain (https://panel.<domain>/<webBasePath>/), protected by basic auth. The panel always stays on 127.0.0.1:3000; Caddy reverse-proxies to it. The root and any path outside webBasePath show a static stub.
settings.externalGenerated: New webBasePath generated — click Apply to save
settings.externalDisableConfirm: Disable external access? The panel will be reachable only via SSH tunnel.
settings.probeSecretDesc: Secret token clients present in headers. Unrecognised clients see the fake site instead.
settings.probeSecretTooShort: Probe secret must be at least 8 characters
settings.probeModeHint: "Bare" matches a known-good reference server. "Secret" requires a special domain to reach the masquerade site.
settings.probeModeUpdated: Probe resistance mode updated — Caddy reloaded
settings.naivePortDesc: Change the HTTPS port for NaiveProxy. Reloads Caddy only — no service restart.
settings.naivePortNote: Changing port will require clients to update their configs.
settings.mieruPortDesc: Change the TCP port range for Mieru. Requires full Mieru restart.
settings.mieruPortNote: UFW rules will be updated automatically. Clients must download new configs.
settings.mieruPortConfirm: Changing Mieru ports will restart the Mieru service. Continue?
settings.trafficDesc: Configure Mieru traffic obfuscation pattern and MTU (default 1400).
settings.udpDesc: TCP-only is recommended and default. Enable UDP only if your network blocks TCP on Mieru ports. Requires full Mieru restart.
settings.udpNote: UDP mode restarts Mieru. Test TCP first — it works on most networks.
settings.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
settings.backupDesc: Export a full backup (all users + all settings) to a single file, or restore it on a fresh server. If the new server uses the same domain (just point DNS to it), existing client keys keep working with no changes.
settings.backupWarn: ⚠ The backup file contains user passwords in plain text. Store it somewhere safe and never share it.
settings.backupBadFile: Not a valid RIXXX panel backup file
settings.backupDomainPrompt:
Restore {n} user(s) from backup.

Keep the DOMAIN/ports FROM THE BACKUP ("{d}")?

• OK = keep backup domain (same DNS → existing client keys keep working)
• Cancel = keep THIS server's current domain (clients must download new keys)
settings.backupImportConfirm: This will OVERWRITE the current users and settings with the backup. Continue?
settings.author: Author
settings.warpDesc: Routes all of the server's outbound traffic through Cloudflare WARP, hiding the server's real IP. Server-wide mode. Mutually exclusive with the cascade: exactly one of three modes is active — native IP / cascade / WARP.
settings.warpPersist: Add to autostart (bring up after reboot). OFF by default — safer: after a reboot WARP will not come up by itself, so server access is guaranteed.
settings.warpSafeNote: SSH and the panel port are NOT routed into the tunnel — server access is preserved. Only outbound proxy traffic goes through WARP.
settings.warpCascadeLock: Cascade is enabled — disable the cascade first. WARP and cascade cannot be used at the same time.
settings.languageDesc: Select web-panel language. Choice is saved in browser.
settings.cascadeDesc: Relay setup: traffic goes through this server (entry) to the exit server, then to the internet. Mieru uses Variant B (mieru-client + redsocks + iptables) — the provider only sees this (entry) server.
settings.cascadeHy2Hint: ℹ Hysteria2 is cascaded automatically through the same Mieru tunnel (matched by process owner) — no separate Hy2 exit address is needed. Just fill in the Mieru exit below and tick this box.
settings.cascadeNaiveUpstreamHint: Format: https://user:pass@host:port (leave blank to skip Naive cascade)
settings.cascadeMieruHostHint: Address of the exit (EU) node running the same script. Leave blank to skip Mieru cascade.
settings.cascadeNote: When enabled, the relay is configured and started (mieru-client + redsocks + iptables) — this can take up to a minute on first setup.
settings.resetCascadeConfirm: Fully reset the cascade? This clears the config, the Caddy upstream and the mita config (keys are restored), removes iptables/redsocks/watchdog, and restarts the services without the cascade. Egress returns to the native IP.
settings.cascadeReset: Cascade reset — egress returned to the native IP
settings.needKeyFirst: Create at least one key first
settings.cascadeNeedOne: Provide a Naive upstream URL and/or a Mieru exit host
settings.cascadePortRangeInvalid: End port must be ≥ start port
settings.externalStubTitle: Stub page (shown at subdomain root / outside webBasePath)
settings.externalStubDesc: Static HTML served by Caddy at the panel subdomain root and any path outside webBasePath. Separate from the naive fake-site. Edit and save to replace it.
settings.externalStubEmpty: Stub HTML must not be empty
settings.externalBaPassKeep: Basic-auth password (leave blank to keep current)
settings.hy2Desc: Hysteria2 is a fast QUIC/UDP protocol. It runs over UDP and coexists with NaiveProxy on TCP/443. Uses the shared user pool and Caddys certificate (no second email).
settings.hy2NotInstalled: Hysteria2 is not yet installed on this server.
settings.hy2PortHint: Default 443/udp (next to Naive TCP/443). Can be changed to 8443 etc.
settings.hy2PortNote: Changing the port restarts Hy2. Clients must update their links.
settings.hy2InstallConfirm: Install Hysteria2 on this server? May take 1-2 minutes.
settings.hy2ReinstallConfirm: Reinstall Hysteria2? The service will restart.
settings.hy2PortConfirm: Change Hy2 port? The service will restart, clients need new links.
settings.subDomainDesc: Optional dedicated domain for client subscription links (e.g. https://sub.example.com). Leave empty to serve sub-links from the panel domain. Caddy auto-provisions the TLS certificate.
settings.subDomainNote: Point an A-record for this host to this server's IP first, otherwise the TLS certificate cannot be issued.

toast.naivePortUpdated: NaiveProxy port updated — clients need new configs
toast.mieruPortsUpdated: Mieru ports updated — service restarted, clients need new configs
